items.statement: The submission documents a converged periodic workflow, identifies the complete LuFeS3O13/R3c input, and supplies structure, DOS and ELF artifacts with reproducibility metadata.
items.expected: Convergence evidence and named artifacts are present; the method choices and stopping/limitation status are explicit.

items.statement: The reported structure is compared to the compound-14 crystallographic model with correct identity and symmetry handling.
items.expected: Lu1, Fe1, S1 and O1–O5 are identified from SI Table S15; R3c and the supplied trigonal cell are retained or any relaxation change is reported.

items.statement: The DOS assessment resolves the source-described orbital-energy regions and element/orbital contributions.
items.expected: O-2s dominates near −20 eV; S-3s/3p and O-2p contribute strongly from about −12 to −6 eV; Fe-3d/O-2p overlap is substantial from about −5 to 0 eV; Lu-4f appears as sharp localized weight slightly below the Fermi level.

items.statement: The localization analysis tests named O, Lu and Lu–O(water) regions rather than relying on an unbound global claim.
items.expected: Localization is high around O in Fe–O/S–O environments, minimal near Lu, and O lobes/Lu–O(water) distribution are asymmetric with the water-bond direction aligned along c.
